title: The participant journey
subtitle: Left to right, from first hearing of The Labs to after a Cycle. The last row is what people told us at each step.

columns.title: Hear of it
do: Hear about The Labs from a friend, LinkedIn, Luma or the map
where: LinkedIn, Luma, the region’s site, word of mouth

columns.title: A first session
do: Come to a free training or workshop
with: A trainer or facilitator, and whoever else came
told: links came from individual trainers, not one place; it felt ad hoc
columns.gap: Only people who stayed have answered so far

columns.title: Make a profile
do: Make an upskiller profile and join the region, free
plan: What a profile gets you is still being worked out

columns.title: Keep coming
do: More trainings and workshops, open lab nights, meetups
told: content from past Cycles should be in one central place
map out pathways so people can watch from the sidelines

columns.title: Get ready for a Cycle
do: Short prep, run by The Labs, so you start the Cycle running
told: everyone sees The Labs through the Cycle; there is no before or after

columns.title: Join a Cycle
do: Sign up, agree your work is public, come to sensemaking
where: The app, Slack, GitHub, an in-person intensive
told: participants struggle to know what’s next and what’s expected right now
important information didn’t flow through Slack

columns.title: A pod: the problem
do: Vote on problem situations, join a pod, research it until you find the paradox
told: a clearer roadmap from individual work into team pods
more guidance on what to work on in a given week

columns.title: A team: the build
do: Vote on frames, join a team, build what it chose
where: GitHub, Claude Code, open lab nights
with: Your team, then your pod, then a mentor once both are stuck
told: joining a project was not obvious
people constantly moving in and out of the project
course-correcting took a long time, even with Labs experts

columns.title: The showcase
do: Show what you built and what you learned

columns.title: After
do: Carry the skill and the record into your work. Some stay to teach, mentor or maintain
plan: Projects that outlast a Cycle, and employers who read the record
where: Wherever you work next; the region, if you stay
with: Your team, if you keep in touch
told: 7 of 11 still in touch with their team
several in new jobs, contracts or job searches
one is building a venture started in the Cycle

in.label: many ways in, one door: the Cycle
